description_en: Changes the ECS security groups to which an instance is added
description_zh: 该接口用于修改指定RDS实例和ECS安全组的关联信息
kebab_example: aliyun rds modify-security-group-configuration --db-instance-id rm-uf6wjk50000 --security-group-id sg-0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifySecurityGroupConfiguration

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query the instance ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the ECS security group. Each instance can be added to up to 10 security groups. Separate multiple security groups with commas (,). To delete an ECS security group, leave this parameter empty. You can call the DescribeSecurityGroups operation to query the ID of the ECS security group
parameters.help_zh: ECS安全组ID。最多支持关联10个安全组，多个安全组用英文逗号（,）隔开。清空ECS安全组请传入空字符串。您可以通过DescribeSecurityGroups查询ECS安全组ID
parameters.name: security_group_id
